target: I-001; scripts/3_cage_case/h14_build_case.py physio load curves (all physio runs before 2026-10-26)
claim: I-001 reproduced and its cause independently confirmed: the twist on the glued cage faces in flexion / extension is the applied axial-rotation moment (Rz) of the physio load curve, which ramped from t 3.5 instead of from its own window (combined loading). It is NOT cage-mesh asymmetry and NOT a stress-sampling artefact. The integrator found the same cause in parallel (DECISIONS.md:735-742) and changed h14 (lines 431-433), but the fix is uncommitted and no corrected run exists yet, so every physio number (ROM, stalls, slip safety, e02) is still wrong until re-run.
evidence: 1) p062 case.feb load curves (printed by roles/redteam/r0001_loads.py): LC23 (Rz) = (3,0)(3.5,0)(8,1)(8.5,0)(9,-1)(9.5,0); LC21 (Rx) = (3,0)(3.5,0)(6,1)... -> at the flexion peak t 4.0 Rz = 167 N mm, Rx = 300 N mm; at the extension peak t 5.0 Rz = 500 N mm, Rx = 900 N mm. 2) roles/redteam/r0001_i001.py on p062 (output r0001_i001_p062_physio.json): face twist Mz(top) rises monotonically with time regardless of the window: 0 (t 3.50) -> 263 (4.40, end of flexion, moment already unloaded) -> 520 (5.36) -> 968 N mm (6.99); Mz / applied Rz = 0.88 / 0.84 / 0.83 at t 4.40 / 5.36 / 6.99. 3) The twist is 100 % mirror-antisymmetric (Mz_anti = Mz at every state) as expected from an applied torque. 4) Cage equilibrium holds: |sum of moments of both faces| <= 30 N mm vs twist up to 1056 N mm (<= 3 %), so the twist is a real model output, not stress sampling. 5) Symmetry (roles/redteam/r0001_symmetry.py): cage nodes mirror within median 0.0005 mm (max 0.2 mm = one voxel), springs FCC / Flaval / IS exactly symmetric, endplate surfaces within 0.004 mm median; only the bone tet meshes are not node-mirrored (median 0.04-0.6 mm, max 1.8 mm) -> cannot produce ~20 % of the bending moment as twist. 6) Across all 76 e02 files (r0001_audit.py): |face twist| / applied Rz median 0.34 (p10 0.27, p90 0.58, n 3787 states, t 3.9-7.5).

fix_options.option: Commit the h14 fix, re-run the physio pre-runs, and accept I-001 as closed only if the flexion / extension face twist falls to the mesh-noise level (proposal: < 5 % of the twist in lateral bending of the same run) - acceptance test written before the re-run

Add a load-schedule check to the h24 preflight: evaluate every rigid-body load curve at each window peak and fail if any off-axis moment exceeds 1 % of M; plus a post-run check of the C3 pot reaction (C3pot.txt) per window
fix_options.risk: low; catches the whole class of deck-building bugs that code-vs-code gates cannot see (see F-0005)

fix_options.option: Unit test for the h14 curve builder (pure function from schedule to points) with the 6-window expected table

summary_zh: 問題 I-001（屈曲與伸展時，黏住的 cage 面上出現扭轉力矩）已由紅隊獨立重現，並確認原因：生理負荷測試的負荷曲線寫錯了。軸向旋轉與側彎的力矩從第 3.5 秒就開始慢慢增加，而不是在各自的時段才施加，所以「屈曲」其實同時帶有扭轉與側彎。證據：p062 這個案例中，扭矩隨時間單調上升（0 → 263 → 520 → 968 牛頓·毫米），即使屈曲力矩已經卸載仍繼續上升；扭矩約等於誤加的軸向力矩的 83–88%；cage 上下兩面的力矩平衡誤差小於 3%，所以不是取樣誤差。cage 網格本身左右對稱。整合者已同時找到此錯誤並修改程式，但修改尚未提交，也還沒有重跑，所以目前所有生理負荷結果仍不可使用。
